subject: DSA
text: In recursion, the base case is the stopping condition that prevents infinite function calls. Without a base case, the function keeps calling itself until stack overflow occurs. A good recursive solution defines the simplest case first and then reduces the original problem into a smaller subproblem of the same type.

subject: PHP
text: Associative arrays in PHP store data in key-value form. Instead of numeric indexes, they use named keys such as name, roll, or marks. They are useful when representing structured records and are commonly used in form handling and database result processing.

subject: Calculus
text: The chain rule is used when one function is inside another function. To differentiate a composite function, first differentiate the outer function and then multiply by the derivative of the inner function. This method is essential in problems involving powers, trigonometric expressions, and exponential forms.

subject: Japanese
text: For JLPT N4 vocabulary preparation, active recall is more effective than passive rereading. Students should test themselves on word meaning, pronunciation, and usage in sentences. Repeated retrieval practice improves retention speed during viva and written assessments.
